shape: Single-portal dead-end (south gate) with two exploration arms + south cross-link
description: Single-portal dead-end stage where the south entry (jn8vx8) fans into two arms: a long WEST/NORTH chain (44qlix → z1qw4m → jhbko6 → qz9f6t) and a shorter EAST chain (upcmke → n25dmk → 7odqgu). A south cross-link (44qlix ↔ upcmke) joins the two arms near the south end, giving a small loop between south_inner / 44qlix / upcmke.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-14.15, 24.29) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side, west column

anchors.description: west wall mid - cross-link to center (matches 44qlix)
central anchor - east arm start, cross-link to west (matches upcmke)

traversalNotes: DEAD-END: single south gate. After exploring, autopilot returns to spawn_south.
Two arms: WEST/NORTH chain (south_inner → west_mid → nw_step → n_step → n_pocket, 5 hops to the N pocket) and EAST chain (south_inner → center → east_c → east_corner, 4 hops to the east corner).
South triangle (south_inner + west_mid + center) lets the autopilot pick either arm without backtracking.
STRICT-BACKBONE on the dead-end arms — single-file after the south triangle.
